correctness.rationale: Explicit projective equations yield the correct incidence congruences for all d≥3. An exact unitary Fourier decomposition of the 3d²-vertex adjacency operator leaves only one constant 3×3 block, 6(d−1) uncoupled axes, 3 two-by-two blocks for each generic r, and at even d one signed 3×3 block at r=d/2. The residual characters lie at −2 and the dimension census is exhaustive. Eigenvalues and multiplicities follow without appeal to finite sampling; Kirchhoff yields the tree formula. An independent exact-integer checker for d=3,...,9 verifies characteristic annihilator, power traces and graph rank; it is corroboration, not all-degree proof. Critical boundary d=3 and even exceptional d=4 were inspected.
